text: Computer vision is a type of technology that helps computers understand and process images. One common use is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify people, places, or things in a picture. Another important function is object detection, which helps a computer find and locate specific objects within an image or video. This technology has many practical applications in our daily lives. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to see the road, recognize traffic signs, and detect other vehicles or pedestrians. It is also used in security cameras and medical imaging. Computer vision is quickly improving and will likely play a bigger role in the future.
